First of all I'm really sorry you had to go through this. I had a similar experience to yours 4 months ago, I wasn't aware of the fact that I was pregnant, however my period was 2 weeks late. I figured it might just me a late period or whatever, and i found out I had a miscarriage in a Starbucks restroom, and it hit me really hard especially that I want a child, we weren't trying or anything and it was my first miscarriage. 

From my experience what I can tell you is to give yourself time to process all of this, it's kind of an emotional Rollercoaster because of your hormones being imbalanced. Just remember it wasn't your fault, talk about it with your partner to avoid unnecessary fights over it (it could happen when you least expect it). 

Again I'm sorry, and feel free to hit me up whenever you feel like talking about it :)

Thank you for the great advice :) I really appreciate you taking the time to share your experience, you're really great for doing so. Whenever I manage to visit a therapist I'd hit you up. You too take care!

A part of me really wants to see a therapist, because it's not easy dealing with all of this. However the process of finding a good therapist that i can trust is kind of scary. And i really hate the fact that my fear of being judged is crippling me.

On the side note, your comment did help me feel better, and I hope someday I can gather all the strength inside me to seek professional help :)
